name: Padded Machine Pullover
definition: A seated fixed-path shoulder-extension isolation on the exact Hammer Strength PL-PO fixture. Both elbows remain on the lever pads while the hands hold the overhead movement arm and the belt-driven cam guides a downward arc. This bent-elbow combined pad-and-handle topology is separate from handled near-straight-arm pullovers and pulldowns. Handled-only, selectorized, unilateral, pad-only, rowing, and elbow-extension variants remain outside it.

variantAxes.description: The lever moves around the supported athlete.
The exact fixture is used seated.

Log total added plate mass on the two work-arm loading rods, excluding storage horns and starting resistance, and compare only on the same fixture.

execution.startingPosition: On the Hammer Strength PL-PO only, log total added plate mass on the two work-arm loading rods; exclude storage horns and starting resistance. Sit against the thirty-degree support, fasten the belt, place both elbows on the pads, and grasp the overhead movement arm.
execution.movement: Pull the movement arm downward through its guided cam path while keeping both elbows on the pads and holding their angle.
execution.endpoint: Stop at the comfortable end of the machine's reduced shoulder-extension path without lifting from the support.
execution.returnPhase: Return the movement arm overhead under control while maintaining the pad and hand contacts.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the elbow angle stable rather than turning the repetition into an elbow-extension press.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso against the support and the belt secured; do not drive through the legs.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lifting either elbow from its pad changes the reviewed combined pad-and-handle interface.
Deliberately extending the elbows changes the movement into a compound press.
Lifting the torso from the support or using the legs adds momentum.
